+class _EcoCycTreeBuilder(ElementTree.TreeBuilder):
+    def doctype(self, name: str, pubid: str | None, system: str | None) -> None:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc XML must not contain a DOCTYPE")
+
+
+def _ecocyc_one(parent: ElementTree.Element, tag: str) -> ElementTree.Element:
+    nodes = parent.findall(tag)
+    if len(nodes) != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"EcoCyc source requires exactly one direct {tag}")
+    return nodes[0]
+
+
+def _ecocyc_text(parent: ElementTree.Element, tag: str, *, native: bool = False) -> str:
+    node = _ecocyc_one(parent, tag)
+    if (len(node) or node.attrib != ({"datatype": "string"} if native else {})
+            or not (node.text or "").strip()):
+        raise ValueError(f"EcoCyc source requires one nonempty native {tag}")
+    return node.text.strip()
+
+
+def _ecocyc_name(node: ElementTree.Element, frame: str) -> str:
+    if (len(node) or node.attrib != {"datatype": "string"}
+            or not (node.text or "").strip()
+            or any(not _metacyc_protein_name_character(ord(c)) for c in node.text)):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc name/alias requires one safe native string")
+    name = _MetaCycProteinName()
+    try:
+        name.feed(node.text.strip())
+        name.close()
+    except ValueError as error:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc name/alias contains unsafe markup") from error
+    label = " ".join("".join(name.parts).split())
+    if (
+        name.tags or not label or "<" in label or ">" in label
+        or re.search(r"&(?:#|[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*;)", label)
+        or any(not _metacyc_protein_name_character(ord(c)) for c in label)
+        or label in {frame, "ECOLI:" + frame, "EcoCyc:" + frame}
+        or label.casefold().startswith(("error", "unknown", "not found"))
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source lacks a resolved native name/alias")
+    return label
+
+
+def _ecocyc_record(
+    kind: str, path: Path, *, url: str, version: str,
+) -> tuple[tuple[str, str, list[str]], str]:
+    """Read one ECOLI complex or regulatory RNA, never a nested frame or xref.
+
+    The observed service serializes its HTTPS transport as HTTP on port 443.
+    This literal compatibility case does not permit HTTP issuing requests.
+    """
+    request = re.fullmatch(
+        rf"https://{re.escape(ECOCYC_HOST)}/getxml\?id=(ECOLI:([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*))",
+        url,
+    )
+    if request is None:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source requires an exact native HTTPS ECOLI request")
+    requested, frame = request.groups()
+    root = ElementTree.fromstring(
+        path.read_bytes(), parser=ElementTree.XMLParser(target=_EcoCycTreeBuilder()),
+    )
+    tag, parent_classes = ECOCYC_SOURCE_TYPES[kind]
+    if root.tag != "ptools-xml" or len(root) != 2:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source requires native metadata and one direct entity")
+    metadata, entity = _ecocyc_one(root, "metadata"), _ecocyc_one(root, tag)
+    base = root.get("{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base", "")
+    if (
+        set(root.attrib) != {"ptools-version", "{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}base"}
+        or base not in {url, f"http://{ECOCYC_HOST}:443/getxml?{requested}"}
+        or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)+", version)
+        or root.get("ptools-version") != version
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc XML base or native version disagrees with the request")
+    if metadata.attrib or sorted(n.tag for n in metadata) != sorted(
+        ["url", "service_name", "query", "num_results", "PGDB"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source has malformed native metadata")
+    if (
+        _ecocyc_text(metadata, "url") not in {
+            f"https://{ECOCYC_HOST}/", f"http://{ECOCYC_HOST}:443/",
+        }
+        or _ecocyc_text(metadata, "service_name") != "getxml"
+        or _ecocyc_text(metadata, "query") != requested
+        or _ecocyc_text(metadata, "num_results") != "1"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc service/query identity mismatch")
+    pgdb = _ecocyc_one(metadata, "PGDB")
+    if (
+        pgdb.attrib != {"orgid": "ECOLI", "version": version}
+        or sorted(n.tag for n in pgdb) != ["dblink", "species", "strain"]
+        or _ecocyc_text(pgdb, "species", native=True) != "Escherichia coli"
+        or _ecocyc_text(pgdb, "strain", native=True) != "K-12 substr. MG1655"
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc PGDB/version/species/strain mismatch")
+    taxonomy = _ecocyc_one(pgdb, "dblink")
+    if (
+        taxonomy.attrib or sorted(n.tag for n in taxonomy) != sorted(
+            ["dblink-db", "dblink-oid", "dblink-relationship", "dblink-URL"]
+        )
+        or _ecocyc_text(taxonomy, "dblink-db") != "NCBI-TAXONOMY-DB"
+        or _ecocyc_text(taxonomy, "dblink-oid") != "511145"
+        or _ecocyc_text(taxonomy, "dblink-relationship") != "unification"
+        or _ecocyc_text(taxonomy, "dblink-URL") != (
+            "http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?mode=Info&id=511145"
+        )
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc native taxon mismatch")
+    if entity.attrib != {"ID": requested, "orgid": "ECOLI", "frameid": frame, "detail": "full"}:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source has a mismatched or unresolved top-level identity")
+    parent = _ecocyc_one(entity, "parent")
+    parent_class = _ecocyc_one(parent, tag)
+    parent_frame = parent_class.get("frameid", "")
+    if (
+        len(parent) != 1 or parent.attrib or (parent.text or "").strip()
+        or len(parent_class) or (parent_class.text or "").strip()
+        or parent_frame not in parent_classes
+        or parent_class.attrib != {
+            "resource": "getxml?ECOLI:" + parent_frame, "orgid": "ECOLI",
+            "frameid": parent_frame, "class": "true",
+        }
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source has a mismatched native RNA/complex parent class")
+    label = _ecocyc_name(_ecocyc_one(entity, "common-name"), frame)
+    synonyms = [_ecocyc_name(node, frame) for node in entity.findall("synonym")]
+    if len(set(synonyms)) != len(synonyms) or label in synonyms:
+        raise ValueError("EcoCyc source contains duplicate native names/aliases")
+    return ("EcoCyc:" + frame, label, sorted(synonyms)), parent_frame

@@ -356,3 +356,38 @@
 with its own digest when assigning the observed release. This records a production
 observation; it does not claim acquisition of a versioned bulk dump. Upstream
 licenses still apply as described by the issuing source.
+
+
+### Native EcoCyc complex and RNA identities
+
+The `ecocyc-protein-xml` and `ecocyc-rna-xml` source kinds establish exact
+`EcoCyc` authority from native ECOLI objects. The current bounded protein
+classes are `Protein-Complexes` and `Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes`; the RNA
+class is `Regulatory-RNAs`. The adapter requires one direct full entity, one
+direct resolved string common-name, and matching native parent identity.
+Only direct native string synonyms become aliases. Names and aliases share
+safe markup/character checks; malformed or duplicated names fail. Nested
+genes, proteins, activities and cross-references are never promoted. There is
+no enzyme-name fallback and no contextual-label exception. The namespace uses
+`canonical_or_synonym` solely for these independently sourced names.
+
+The issuing URL must be exactly
+`https://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr/getxml?id=ECOLI:FRAME`.
+The request, XML base, metadata service/query, PGDB/version, species, strain
+and NCBITaxon 511145 must agree. The native originals serialize their XML base
+as `http://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr:443/getxml?ECOLI:FRAME` and service as
+`http://bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr:443/`; only those literal legacy forms
+are accepted alongside the exact HTTPS forms. This serialization exception
+does not permit HTTP issuing requests, arbitrary mirrors or alternate ports.
+DTD/entity declarations are rejected during XML parsing, including UTF-16.
+Duplicate identities must agree on type, parent, name, aliases and version;
+conflicting ECOLI releases fail before corpus filtering. Unsupported upstream
+serialization changes require a reviewed adapter change.
+
+`EcoCyc:CPLX0-226` names the CRP–cAMP complex, `EcoCyc:PC00004` the CRP
+complex, and `EcoCyc:RNA0-241` SgrS RNA. Identifier authority does not infer
+component coefficients, sequence equivalence or regulatory effects. Preserve
+explicit `complex` and `rna` categories in curated records; graph labels and
+KGX retain them without a prefix-wide reaction classification. Public citations
+use `https://ecocyc.org/gene?id=LOCAL_ID`. Acquisition receipts and full original
+bytes remain outside curated records, and public-release licensing is deferred.

@@ -0,0 +1,426 @@
+"""Native EcoCyc identity boundaries; fixtures do not establish pathway biology."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tarfile
+from pathlib import Path
+from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
+
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+from pathwaymech.cli import _record_page, _reference_url
+from pathwaymech.graph_view import _declared_nodes
+from pathwaymech.identifiers import identifier_errors
+from pathwaymech.kgx import kgx_nodes
+from pathwaymech.schema import ValidationError, validate_record
+from pathwaymech.strict import TARGET_CLASS, validator
+from scripts.build_source_identifier_snapshot import build_snapshot, source_terms
+
+HOST = "bf2i-artsymbiocyc.insa-lyon.fr"
+FRAME = "CPLX0-226"
+URL = f"https://{HOST}/getxml?id=ECOLI:{FRAME}"
+LABEL = "CRP-cyclic-AMP DNA-binding transcriptional dual regulator"
+VERSION = "27.0"
+KIND = "ecocyc-protein-xml"
+NATIVE = f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="iso-8859-1"?>
+<ptools-xml ptools-version="27.0" xml:base="http://{HOST}:443/getxml?ECOLI:{FRAME}">
+<metadata><url>http://{HOST}:443/</url><service_name>getxml</service_name>
+<query>ECOLI:{FRAME}</query><num_results>1</num_results>
+<PGDB orgid="ECOLI" version="27.0"><species datatype="string">Escherichia coli</species>
+<strain datatype="string">K-12 substr. MG1655</strain><dblink>
+<dblink-db>NCBI-TAXONOMY-DB</dblink-db><dblink-oid>511145</dblink-oid>
+<dblink-relationship>unification</dblink-relationship>
+<dblink-URL>http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Taxonomy/Browser/wwwtax.cgi?mode=Info&id=511145</dblink-URL>
+</dblink></PGDB></metadata>
+<Protein ID="ECOLI:{FRAME}" orgid="ECOLI" frameid="{FRAME}" detail="full">
+<parent><Protein resource="getxml?ECOLI:Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes" orgid="ECOLI"
+frameid="Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes" class="true"/></parent>
+<common-name datatype="string">{LABEL}</common-name><synonym datatype="string">CRP-cAMP</synonym>
+<component><Protein resource="getxml?ECOLI:PC00004" orgid="ECOLI" frameid="PC00004"/></component>
+<component><Compound resource="getxml?ECOLI:CAMP" orgid="ECOLI" frameid="CAMP"/></component>
+</Protein></ptools-xml>'''
+
+
+def native():
+    return ET.fromstring(NATIVE)
+
+
+def parse(tmp_path, document=None, *, url=URL, version=VERSION, kind=KIND):
+    path = tmp_path / "source.xml"
+    if document is None:
+        document = native()
+    if isinstance(document, ET.Element):
+        document = ET.tostring(document, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
+    elif isinstance(document, str):
+        document = document.encode("iso-8859-1")
+    path.write_bytes(document)
+    return list(source_terms(kind, path, url=url, version=version))
+
+
+def test_direct_native_name_and_only_direct_synonym(tmp_path):
+    tree = native()
+    nested = ET.SubElement(tree.find("Protein"), "nested")
+    ET.SubElement(nested, "common-name", datatype="string").text = "Nested object, not an alias"
+    ET.SubElement(nested, "synonym", datatype="string").text = "Nested alias"
+    assert parse(tmp_path, tree) == [("EcoCyc:" + FRAME, LABEL, ["CRP-cAMP"])]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("frame,tag,parent,label,synonyms,kind", [
+    ("CPLX0-226", "Protein", "Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes", LABEL, ["CRP-cAMP"], KIND),
+    ("PC00004", "Protein", "Protein-Complexes", "DNA-binding transcriptional dual regulator CRP",
+     ["CRP"], KIND),
+    ("RNA0-241", "RNA", "Regulatory-RNAs", "small regulatory RNA SgrS", ["SgrS", "RyaA"],
+     "ecocyc-rna-xml"),
+])
+def test_three_native_shapes(tmp_path, frame, tag, parent, label, synonyms, kind):
+    text = NATIVE.replace(FRAME, frame).replace("Protein-Small-Molecule-Complexes", parent)
+    tree = ET.fromstring(text)
+    entity = tree.find("Protein")
+    entity.tag = tag
+    entity.find("parent/Protein").tag = tag
+    entity.find("common-name").text = label
+    for node in entity.findall("synonym"):
+        entity.remove(node)
+    for alias in synonyms:
+        ET.SubElement(entity, "synonym", datatype="string").text = alias
+    assert parse(tmp_path, tree, url=URL.replace(FRAME, frame), kind=kind) == [
+        ("EcoCyc:" + frame, label, sorted(synonyms))]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("path,key,value", [
+    (".", "ptools-version", "28.0"),
+    ("metadata/PGDB", "orgid", "META"),
+    ("metadata/PGDB", "version", "28.0"),
+    ("metadata/PGDB/species", "datatype", "integer"),
+    ("metadata/PGDB/strain", "datatype", "symbol"),
+    ("Protein", "ID", "ECOLI:PC00004"),
+    ("Protein", "orgid", "META"),
+    ("Protein", "frameid", "PC00004"),
+    ("Protein", "detail", "low"),
+    ("Protein", "class", "true"),
